requirement_vague: Getting a specific todo by ID returns the correct todo
requirement_precise: Register a user and login. Create a todo with title 'My Test Todo'. Use the returned todo ID to call GET /todos/{id}. Verify the response status is 200 OK, the returned todo has the same ID and title 'My Test Todo', and isComplete is false.

implementation.location: GET /todos/{id} in get_todo; POST /todos in create_todo
implementation.reasoning: The service defines an authenticated GET /todos/{id} endpoint that looks up the todo by the provided ID for the current user and returns it with response_model TodoResponse, which includes id, title, and isComplete. Todo creation defaults isComplete to false via TodoCreate and Todo model defaults, so creating a todo with title 'My Test Todo' and then fetching it by the returned ID will return 200 OK with the same id, title, and isComplete=false.
